title: Chromatic Gault - Location, Weakness & Rewards
description: Chromatic Gault in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A Chromatic Gault. Three elements matter here - Fire lands, Ice and Lightning are resisted, and Earth is absorbed, so an Earth-based skill is a net loss on this fight.

sections.title: Where to Find the Chromatic Gault
sections.content:
Location: The Monolith, Falling Leaves.

Availability: Act 2.

Chromatic enemies are optional, supercharged versions of an enemy you already fought. They are not required for the story, but they drop the better tier of materials and the weapons tied to their base enemy.

Bring Fire damage. Ice, Lightning is resisted, so those turns are wasted.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
• Higher-tier Chroma materials than the base Gault
  • Weapons and Pictos gated behind defeating the Chromatic Gault

Exact drop quantities for this encounter are not documented in the sources we could verify, so they are not listed rather than estimated.

sections.title: How to Beat the Chromatic Gault
sections.content:
Same answer as the base enemy

The Chromatic Gault keeps the weaknesses and resistances of the ordinary Gault. If you have already fought the base version, your party does not need to change - what changes is the margin for error.

What actually kills you

Chromatic variants hit harder and hold more health than the enemy they are based on. The failure mode is almost always running out of resources mid-fight rather than a mechanic you did not understand, so bring healing headroom rather than a greedier damage build.
